text:
maya: quick note — after yesterday's microkernel tweak i see a weird uplift in per-token tail latency on a handful of routes. sampled a few traces, looks like more time spent in kernel selection & context handoff than before. putting raw notes here so we don't lose them.

alex: thx. can you paste the profiler snippet you grabbed?

maya: sure, here's a single-token trace (redacted ids):
```
trace_id: 0xabc123
route: /chat/assistant.v1
seq_len: 1
metrics_ms: { prequeue: 0.4, queue_wait: 1.2, kernel_select: 3.6, kernel_launch: 0.8, kv_lookup: 0.1, decode: 2.3 }
note: kernel_select time used to be ~0.7ms median for this route
```

cheng: interesting. did the microkernel change include extra model-compat checks? those can escalate selection cost if we're not caching the decision.

maya: yes — we added a fallback-check for fused-attn variants. we expected a tiny hit but not 3x. looks like selection cache misses are high for warm requests.

infra-bot: perf-regression-alert: job=perf-nightly, metric=token_p99_latency, route=/chat/assistant.v1, delta=+18%. See run 2312345600 for diffs.

alex: we should avoid inflating TTFT attribution to "kernel_select" without finer labels. propose: split kernel_select into `kernel_route_lookup_ms`, `kernel_compat_check_ms`, `kernel_policy_eval_ms`. that will let dashboard attribute precise cause.

liz: agreed. also we need per-route sampling so the dashboard doesn't mix system routes with latency-sensitive product routes. suggest sampling keys: {route, model_variant, seq_bucket} and store p50/p95/p99.

sam: +1. for seq_bucket use [1, 2-16, 17-64, 65+]. many regressions show up only on short seqs.

maya: actionable checklist: 
- add three new metrics emitted on token completion: `token.kernel_route_lookup_ms`, `token.kernel_compat_check_ms`, `token.kernel_policy_eval_ms` (counters with ms histograms)
- include `route_tag` and `model_variant` as labels
- emit an event line with `correlation_id` for trace joins
- add a sampling layer: always sample 100% for routes in critical list, otherwise 1% stratified by seq_bucket

alex: for logs, propose a compact JSON line: 
```
{
  "ts": 2312345678,
  "cid": "cid-xxxx",
  "route": "/chat/assistant.v1",
  "model": "gpt-small-q4",
  "seq": 1,
  "token_metrics": {"prequeue_ms":0.4, "queue_ms":1.2, "kernel_route_lookup_ms":3.2, "kernel_compat_check_ms":0.4, "kernel_policy_eval_ms":0.0, "kv_ms":0.1, "decode_ms":2.3},
  "stage":"token_done"
}
```

cheng: +1 to fields. also add `kernel_decision_cache_hit` boolean so we can correlate cache misses.

liz: dashboard panels: 
- token path waterfall (stacked p95) with the new kernel sublabels
- per-route p99 heatmap by seq_bucket
- kernel decision cache hit rate over time by model_variant

maya: will open a PR to add metrics + sample config. plan: land instrumentation behind a flag, run perf-smoke, then flip for the critical routes.

sam: can we also hook the eval-runner to run regression checks on these new token-level metrics? automated alert if kernel_compat_check_ms p95 increases >30% week-over-week.

alex: yep i'll add alert rule draft to infra repo. one more ask: keep the emitted histograms with explicit upper bounds so we don't explode buckets (e.g., 0.1ms..100ms).

maya: sweet. i'll post the PR link once ready. tagging folks for review: @alex @cheng @liz.

infra-bot: deployment-note: instrumentation flag will be added to canary group `runtime-canary-2`.

alex: tiny nit — call the metric namespace `runtime_token_*` not `token_*` to avoid clash with embeddings counters.

maya: good catch. i'll use `runtime_token.kernel_route_lookup_ms` etc.

cheng: ok, sounds like a plan. thanks for catching this early.

liz: thanks — once PR is up i'll mock dashboard panels and share screenshots in this thread. :eyes:
